o.norm: demonstrate tolerance of irrelevant high-order digits:
64 values Enum (to test whether no int<->long jdk conversion issue exists)

i.norm:
Asserts that decoding the given bit-vector {@code values} for {@link Traffic} produces exactly the {@code expected} set of constants.

The {@code values} are forwarded verbatim to the varargs method, so a single argument exercises the single-vector path and two arguments exercise the multi-vector path.
Single bit-vector: each bit (1, 2, 4) maps to one Traffic constant.
Two bit-vectors: the leading 0L is the (empty) high-order word; the low-order word carries the same bits as above.
High-order word holds bits beyond the enum's range (666L); they must be ignored, so results match the low-order word alone.
64-constant enum: confirm bits 31, 32 and 63 decode correctly with no int<->long conversion issues. Long.MIN_VALUE is bit 63 (the sign bit).
